summary: Engineering plan written: every spec decision mapped to a file, 12 risks each with a detection path, 13 pre-flight gates, ADR-0021 referenced. No blocking open question.

Lineup column shipped end to end. Every gate passes at 100 percent coverage. Two plan deviations: the migration is nullable because Aurora DSQL rejects every constraint on ADD COLUMN, and on a phone the column sits on the artist line because inline it collapsed the title to one character. One ratified metric remains unmet and needs a product call: a twenty character title truncates at 360 px, and did so before this branch added a column.
